text.en:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Racun (Pindaan Senarai Racun) 2023.

Pindaan Jadual Pertama

2. Akta Racun 1952 dipinda dalam Jadual Pertama, dalam Senarai Racun, dalam senarai "Alkaloids; the following: their salts, simple

or complex; their quaternary compounds:", dengan menggantikan butiran "Nicotine" dan butir-butir yang berhubungan dengannya

dengan butiran dan butir-butir yang berikut:

Names Part I Part II Exempt

Group A Group B Group C Group D

"Nicotine - - All preparations

unless exempted

- - (1) Tobacco

(2) Product in the form of patch

or gum to be used as an aid

for smoking cessation, which

is registered under the

Control of Drugs and

Cosmetics Regulations 1984

(3) Preparation of a kind used

for smoking through

electronic cigarette and

electric vaporizing device, in

the form of liquid or gel".

Dibuat 31 Mac 2023

[KKM.600-18/2/95; PN(PU2)172/XIX]

 DR. ZALIHA BINTI MUSTAFA

 Menteri Kesihatan

POISONS ACT 1952

POISONS (AMENDMENT OF POISONS LIST) ORDER 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 6 of the Poisons Act 1952 [Act 366], the Minister, after consultation with

the Poisons Board, makes the following order:
